actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA-level identity evidence (proliferation/EMT up, metabolic pathways down) with stable internal structure (ARI 0.79) and no technical confounder association. Boundaries are weak but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 shows the strongest convergent multi-modal identity evidence (WNT/TGF-beta/Notch RNA, PBRM1 enrichment, CNV differences) with positive probe support across all modalities and no confounder association. No positive structural evidence indicates split or merge, so it is retained.

C0003 is defined by striking BAP1 mutation enrichment with concordant RNA pathway shifts and no technical confounder association. Internal structure is estimable with moderate stability and no positive evidence supports structural revision, so it is retained.

C0004 lacks significant biological support in any modality, and a technical confounder (CT phase NEPH) is significantly associated with membership, providing a plausible competing explanation for its WXS-dominated structure. No credible structural revision resolves this, so it is dropped.

C0005 has strong, coherent WXS-driven identity evidence (significant VHL and PBRM1 depletion) with concordant RNA trends and no technical confounder association. No positive structural evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained despite weak cross-modal membership support.

C0006 rests on only 8 patients with a fragile RNA/WXS signal and wide confidence intervals; biological support is present but insufficiently defensible, and no structural revision is indicated. It is dropped as not adequately supported at this stage.
